metadata.title: convert: brachy HDR/PDR dwells as dwell.parquet (#282)

tasks.title: dwell_table module: DWELL_SCHEMA, REASON_DWELL, dwell_rows(plan, ct) one row per paired-CP dwell, plus synthetic brachy writer extensions
tasks.test_approach: TDD in tests/test_dwell_table.py on synthetic brachy RTPLANs written with save_as and read back with dcmread (dicom_io.read_header_core where the existing ion tests do), modelled on tests/test_ion_plan_table.py. Extend tests/synthetic_dicom.write_rtplan/_channel with treatment_type (default None), per-channel total_time, final_weight, source_number, movement_type, pulses/pulse_interval, and a SourceSequence; DS values written as DS-legal strings (<= 16 chars). Module mirrors ion_plan_table.py structure (spec: Which plans, Columns, Malformed). The AST test names dicom_io private helpers (_pydicom_quiet); commit with CLAUDE_ALLOW_PRIVATE_API=1 and list them in the commit body, as tests/test_ion_plan_table.py's AST test did.
criteria: An HDR plan with 2 STEPWISE channels of 3 paired-CP dwells each (one zero-time) gives 6 rows in setup, channel, dwell_index order; the zero-time dwell is present with dwell_weight 0 and dwell_time_s 0

dwell_time_s equals channel_total_time x dwell_weight / final_cumulative_time_weight for a hand-computed dwell, and per channel sum(dwell_time_s) equals ChannelTotalTime within rel 1e-9 for binary-exact weights and within rel 1e-4 for DS-rounded weights
position_x/y/z equal ControlPoint3DPosition of CP 2k and position_i/j/k equal ct.TransformPhysicalPointToContinuousIndex of that point; control_point_index is the ControlPointIndex of CP 2k

Setup, channel, source (isotope, half-life, RAKR, strength reference date/time via ReferencedSourceNumber), source_movement_type and pulse columns hold the plan's values; nullable columns absent from the plan are null
A PDR plan fills number_of_pulses and pulse_repetition_interval and stores dwell_time_s from ChannelTotalTime unchanged

dwell_rows returns None (and the module logs nothing) for: BrachyTreatmentType LDR, MDR, MANUAL or absent; a channel with SourceMovementType OSCILLATING or UNIDIRECTIONAL; a plan with BeamSequence or IonBeamSequence; a plan where no channel in any setup has control points
Each malformed case listed in spec acceptance test 5 alone raises CaseRefused(REASON_DWELL) (one parametrized test), including the channel-sum drift fixture of many sub-tolerance inter-pair gaps
to_table(rows) has schema equal to DWELL_SCHEMA and null_count 0 in every non-nullable column for the valid fixtures (vault: Patterns/python/pyarrow-schema-does-not-enforce-non-nullable-fields.md)

An AST test shows dwell_table.py raises only CaseRefused(REASON_DWELL), has no try/except, no reference to quiet_call or _pydicom_quiet, and imports none of plan_table, ion_plan_table, beam_volume, fluence
Multi-valued FL/DS tags are accepted both as pydicom MultiValue and as list (vault: Patterns/medical-imaging/pydicom-binary-vr-multivalue-reads-back-as-list.md)
Every pre-existing test using write_rtplan passes unmodified (treatment_type defaults to None)

A channel with FinalCumulativeTimeWeight 0, ChannelTotalTime 0 and all weights 0 gives its rows with dwell_weight 0 and dwell_time_s 0 (no division); final 0 with ChannelTotalTime != 0 raises CaseRefused(REASON_DWELL)

A decrease between consecutive CPs of at most DWELL_WEIGHT_TOLERANCE x final passes, and a dwell whose w_{2k+1} < w_{2k} by that much gets dwell_weight 0; a larger decrease is refused; the same tolerance applies to CP 0 vs 0, last vs final, and w_{2k+2} vs w_{2k+1}
REASON_DWELL equals the spec string verbatim; DWELL_WEIGHT_TOLERANCE == 1e-4; PAIR_ATOL_MM == 0.1, and a pair 0.1 mm apart on one axis passes while 0.1001 mm is refused
Tests read every fixture through dicom_io.read_header_core (vault: Patterns/python/pydicom-validates-lazily-on-first-tag-access.md)

tasks.title: preprocess and manifest carry dwell.parquet: new kind, kept name, geometric re-index of position_i/j/k
tasks.test_approach: TDD following the existing ion_plan tests in tests/test_preprocess.py and tests/test_manifest.py (spec: Integration, preprocess and manifest bullets).
criteria: dwell is in preprocess.KINDS and in both keep-the-name tuples; series.json rows of kind dwell pass check_rows
index_plan_table takes a point-column prefix defaulting to 'isocenter'; existing plan and ion_plan calls and tests are unchanged

On a geometric run, dwell.parquet's position_i/j/k are rewritten to the continuous index of position_x/y/z on the final CT and every other column is unchanged; on a non-geometric run the file is copied byte-identical

A dwell.parquet that is unreadable or not DWELL_SCHEMA is skipped with the REASON_PLAN_INDEX warning, whose text keeps 'plan table' and names plan.parquet, ion_plan.parquet and dwell.parquet; the docstrings at preprocess.py:10 and manifest.py:6,49 list dwell
manifest adds a 'dwell' key with the file name when the plan has a dwell series.json row, after ion_plan, and omits it otherwise

tasks.title: convert writes dwell.parquet and its series.json row
tasks.test_approach: TDD in tests/test_convert.py following the ion_plan convert tests (spec: Integration, convert bullet; acceptance tests 5 and 6).
criteria: convert on a synthetic HDR brachy case writes dwell.parquet (schema DWELL_SCHEMA) in the plan folder and a series.json row of kind dwell, modality RTPLAN, with the same string-valued key set as every other row and dicom from (metadata.ALL, metadata.RTPLAN); frame_of_reference_uid is the plan's FrameOfReferenceUID, '' when absent (one fixture without it)
The dwell call runs in its own (fifth) catch before case_dir.mkdir, independent of the ion catch, with to_table outside _header_call
A malformed HDR plan converts without dwell.parquet, with CT, dose, masks and applicator files unchanged, and logs exactly one WARNING 'convert: <REASON_DWELL>' with no UID, label or value
Existing brachy fixtures (no BrachyTreatmentType), photon and ion plans produce no dwell.parquet and no new log line
The full suite passes: uv run --group dev pytest -q --tb=short, and ruff check is clean
